propositions: The edit command must accept a --review valueless flag that invokes review_plan after the EDIT event commits and maps the verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040.

The claim command must accept a --review flag that checks the plan-review gate applicability and verdict before attempting the claim, proceeding only on PASS and exiting with the verdict code on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable failure.
Both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import from _llm_commands and must not hold the store lock during review execution.

The claim --review flag must sense gate applicability through a shared _plan_review_gate_applies helper and must print a skip notice when the gate does not apply, never propagating the flag through the parent cascade.
A raised exception from review_plan must propagate through the standard CLI error handler, with the edit remaining committed and the claim core never invoked.

Help texts and generated documentation must document non-atomicity against concurrent reconvergence and reference review-plan --status; exit-code documentation must specify that --review codes apply only when the flag is passed.
